task: Change front-card leave animation to a downward drop per .omc/plans/card-leave-drop-animation.md

stories.title: Front-card leave animation drops downward instead of sliding sideways
acceptanceCriteria: The oldPos === 0 keyframe branch in animateAdvance() (script.js) no longer contains translateX or rotate in its mid-transition keyframe
The mid-transition keyframe for the leaving card contains a positive translateY value (downward drop)
Only transform and opacity are keyframed (no other CSS properties animated)
Clicking dots 1->2->3->4->1 still updates front card content correctly each time (regression)
Rapid repeated clicking during an in-flight animation still does not desync stack order (isAnimating guard still effective)
No console errors on load or during transitions
A mid-animation screenshot shows the leaving card visibly offset downward from its resting pos-0 transform, not sideways
